projects.title: Storico
projects.shortDescription: LLM-powered tool that turns natural language user stories into structured Kanban tasks.
projects.longDescription: **Storico** is an LLM-powered tool that automates decomposing natural language user stories into structured Kanban tasks. A hexagonal FastAPI backend validates each story against the user story format (As a(n) … I want … so that …), extracts its actor, action and benefit, and generates editable, versioned tasks with local Ollama models or a cloud provider. The Astro and React frontend turns those tasks into a Kanban board you can restructure, and any selection can be exported as CSV, JSON or Markdown, or sent straight to a Trello board. It is my Master's thesis project at the Technological University of the Mixteca (UTM) in Oaxaca, Mexico.
projects.stack: Python, FastAPI, Astro, React, PostgreSQL, Ollama

projects.title: Flowmodoro
projects.shortDescription: Focus timer that counts up while you work and turns your flow time into a proportional break.
projects.longDescription: **Flowmodoro** is a focus timer that drops the rigid Pomodoro intervals: it counts **up** while you work and, when you decide to stop, calculates a proportional break — around 20% of the session by default, adjustable from 8% to 50%. The Expo and React Native Android app installs from a direct download, keeps every session on the device, and on the Pro plan adds cloud sync, deeper statistics and the automation extras, backed by Supabase and Stripe. Alarms, notifications and an optional auto-focus cycle after each break complete the flow.
projects.stack: Expo, React Native, TypeScript, Supabase, Stripe

projects.title: LocalLLM-DataForge
projects.shortDescription: A simplified Distilabel-inspired pipeline for synthetic dataset creation using pandas DataFrames and local Ollama models.
projects.longDescription: **LocalLLM-DataForge** is a data pipeline architecture for decomposing user stories into development tasks using local LLMs with Ollama. Inspired by Distilabel, it organizes processing following the natural data flow: Input → LLM Processing → Validation/Repair → Output. Features native pandas DataFrame support, step-based processing architecture, automatic caching, parallel batch processing, LLM-as-a-judge validation, dual generator comparison, and JSON repair for robust LLM output handling.

projects.title: search-intranet
projects.shortDescription: A search engine to CUJAE 's Intranet
projects.longDescription: At the José Antonio Echeverría University (CUJAE) in Havana, Cuba, there is a search engine for the Intranet. This engine is not only efficient in searching and locating relevant information, but it also interacts with a Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP). In the case of CUJAE, this allows the search engine to access directory information, such as user details and network structure, to provide more accurate and personalized search results. It’s worth noting that this search engine is only available on the internal network of the university campus.

projects.longDescription: **aterm** is a static website or portfolio, that looks like a terminal. projects.title: Trivial
projects.shortDescription: A game where players are asked questions on different topics and have to get as many answers as possible right.
projects.longDescription: **Trivial** is a type of game in which players are asked questions about different topics and they have to get as many correct answers as possible. Besides having the benefit of improving and expanding your knowledge, either general or in more specific areas, this style of game is designed so that the contestants have fun playing, and its main objective is to create discussion and healthy debate among participants. In fact it is not mandatory that Trivia winners have to get a prize and almost everyone is ok with that as their main objective is to have fun and learn at the same time. Trivia questions and answers can be adapted to any audience and can be used in schools and universities to assist in language skills development and to test knowledge and skills levels.
projects.stack: JavaScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, Chakra UI
